scope: missing_reciprocal_hreflang: real missing return annotations and existing language-code collisions on isolated Hugo/Nuxt fixtures

corrector_changes.targeting: Evidence identifies the translation receiving the return annotation. Resolved route files override the flagged source-page targets, including at a one-file limit.
corrector_changes.nuxt: Standalone literal link objects inside one parseable useHead object are cloned with quotes, property order, indentation and commas preserved. Computed/spread/ambiguous structures abstain.
corrector_changes.collision: An existing language code for another URL is never overwritten. Preparation refuses all-conflict batches before any file read; mixed batches retain repairable items and explain the conflict in the PR body.
corrector_changes.safety: Malformed language codes, non-HTTP URLs, control characters, angle brackets and contradictory evidence abstain. HTML attribute values and JavaScript quotes are escaped. Mixed HTML attribute shapes and unsupported JavaScript escapes abstain; entity-encoded existing language codes cannot create duplicate annotations.
corrector_changes.ai: The live bench forbids AI targeting and installs a hard zero-call provider budget. Return-tag generation is mechanical with AI rewrite fallback disabled; unresolved route targeting outside this controlled run is not universally certified as zero-cost.

measurement.projection: A separate copy of structured URL fields maps the preview host to the production namespace, preserving URL paths/case/query. Only the exact noindex header on preview-host pages is removed; meta robots and all other directives remain. The original scorer uses the actual captured sitemap XML.
measurement.positive_control: Three fixture translations form a genuine missing FR-to-EN return pair. The unchanged built baseline must expose the exact page/code/URL evidence before any repair.
measurement.raw_html_countercheck: After the real correction build, the EN response is HTTP 200 and contains fr pointing to the FR translation. Its previous en, de and x-default annotations, canonical and meta robots are unchanged.
measurement.remaining_occurrence: Legacy fr-code collision requires language ownership/arbitration and is deliberately unchanged.

initial_inconclusive_attempts.reason: New translations absent from the served static sitemap and navigation; positive control not visited.
The served sitemap included the translations but its production-host URLs did not seed the preview crawl. Relative navigation links were required.

verification.independent_countercheck: GitHub main identities, PR draft/closed/unmerged state and exact built heads were re-read. Compare shows exactly one translation changed per stack. Raw HTML confirms the new return tag and unchanged existing annotations/canonical/meta robots. The final projection also preserves noindex on redirects leaving the preview host; its pages and removed-header lists match all four recorded live reports exactly.
verification.postgresql: No new PostgreSQL run in this content-only phase; earlier real recovery/concurrency evidence remains separate.

limitations: The preview remains noindex in reality. Its projected scores are not an actual production crawl or a proof of search-engine indexing.
Hugo raw_head and bounded literal Nuxt useHead are exercised. Arbitrary customer/shared/dynamic templates, multiline objects, quoted object keys and other frameworks are not universally certified.
The unresolved legacy language-code collision is not safely repairable without deciding which translation owns that language code.
Hreflang invalid-code and x-default families and remaining title/duplicate/content AI-written families were not exercised by this selection.
This does not certify customer billing, scheduling, live billable batches or partial-content-write crash recovery. No agent deployment or client write occurred.
remaining_release_checks: Validate hreflang invalid codes and x-default with bounded Claude and independent positive controls.
Complete explicitly selected remaining AI-written families, including duplicate descriptions and titles.
Exercise real billable batch and partial-content-write recovery with GitHub and isolated PostgreSQL together.
Validate deployment startup/schedulers, capacity, receipt retention and onboarding/billing lifecycle, then supervise pilots.
